backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functions or state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a header logo update affecting Header.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React layout rendering Header, all marketing sections, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer displaying the shared logo, copyright info, and sustainability tagline.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Header: Fixed header with scroll-aware styling, smooth nav links, mobile menu, and a logo image with fallback behavior.
frontend/src/components/marketing/logo.t: Exports a shared logo asset path and alt text used across components.
frontend/src/components/marketing/sectio: About section explaining the bagasse process with three themed feature cards.
Benefits section listing four product advantages and a sustainability stats panel.
Marketing section describing compostability features with icons and a step-by-step composting process.
Contact section providing email info and a card about learning more for partnerships or bulk orders.
FAQ accordion component with expandable questions about product safety, durability, composting, and usage.
Hero section with eco-friendly tagline, CTAs that scroll smoothly, and an infographic image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and managing an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider for handling Internet Identity login, state, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing because the backend has no methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, light/dark palettes, base styles, and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, global styles, and rendering the root app.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, issues, and logo-replacement requirements for the current build state.
